name: transfer

name: x402_request
description: Make an HTTP request to an x402 payment-gated endpoint. Handles the full flow: sends the initial request, parses any 402 challenge, signs an EIP-3009 or Permit2

url.description: Target endpoint URL. Must be HTTPS. Resolves via DNS; private/local IPs are rejected before any payment.

body.description: Pre-serialized request body. For JSON payloads, pass JSON.stringify(...) on the caller side.

maxPaymentAtomic.description: Hard cap on payment amount in the asset's smallest atomic unit (integer string, e.g. "10000" = 0.01 USDC at 6 decimals). If the server demands more than this cap, the call returns code: 'PAYMENT_AMOUNT_EXCEEDED' rather than overpaying. The user has pre-committed to this cap — do NOT raise it without asking the user.

autoApprove.description: When true (default), silently grants an UNLIMITED Permit2 allowance if the endpoint requires it — DANGEROUS, see SAFETY in the action description. Defaults true because MCP agents cannot interact with a prompt, but you MUST consult the user before relying on this on any endpoint you have not paid before. Set to false to surface code: 'PERMIT2_APPROVAL_REQUIRED' instead and route approval out-of-band.

preferNetwork.description: Optional override: restrict payment to this chain when the endpoint offers multiple. Pass the `chain` of a quoted option ("base"); other chain forms ("eip155:8453", "8453") are resolved too. Use this when the user has a balance on a specific chain — without it, the picker chooses based on transfer-method preference (EIP-3009 over Permit2), which can land on a chain where the wallet has no funds. If no offered entry matches, the call returns code: 'NO_MATCHING_ROUTE' with the list of offered networks so you can re-ask the user.

preferMethod.description: Optional override: restrict payment to this transfer method ("eip3009", "permit2", or "permit2-exact"). Case-insensitive. Use this to force the gasless route (eip3009) or to insist on a specific Permit2 variant. If no offered entry matches, the call returns code: 'NO_MATCHING_ROUTE'.

preferAsset.description: Optional override: restrict payment to entries matching this asset. Matches the entry's `asset` field (contract address, exact, case-insensitive) or its `tokenName` field (substring, case-insensitive). Pass the exact value from the quote's output. Returns code: 'NO_MATCHING_ROUTE' when nothing matches.
